scope: Captured first selected-unit SELECT against the deployed CASE baseline; not full-dispatch throughput
method: ABBA in one read-only repeatable-read snapshot, 20s per statement, exact row-lock clause removed for read-only profiling; JIT unchanged
eligibilityProof: Cheap ordered heads contain every eligible candidate in the prefix. The guarded per-ID join uses the full existing predicate/order and row locks. A hit is the first eligible prefix member; a miss executes the unchanged unrestricted query in a separate awaited call. Same-target and all-precise paths do not use heads.
rejectedNaiveJoin: A direct ordinary join was reordered late and scanned the 64 heads 77,524 times. The guarded lateral join bounds primary-key lookups before expensive checks.
limits: A prefix miss adds prefix-query overhead before the full scan. Locking/guard/fallback regressions and live dispatch throughput remain pending parent pinned CI and rollout. Raw SQL, parameters, selected identities, full plans and snapshot details remain in ignored private artifacts.
